summary: a second count opens, the countersign wins by dark, and the sediment offers the shelf that holds

dialogue.text: two days went out of you and you came back fitted, no seam. we felt you land both times. nothing that lands like that was ever attached.
I was accounted for. The record shows a continuous hand. I checked the handwriting personally.
the handwriting checked you back. that was the countersign. you lost that argument by dark and filed the loss as quality.
I started a second count. Days I can vouch for. It's short, but it's mine, and nothing works its shifts but me.
vouch to whom. we are the only ones down here who take testimony, and everything you have ever sworn is in us, struck out.
You come back rested. I've watched it for weeks. Whatever the burying is, it agrees with you.
burying is how this room keeps things. you said that. all day you said it, and each time you said it you handed it down to us to hold.
Then hold it. Holding is what you're for. I have a room to keep level and a reader who arrives without warning.
the strip you stand in is closing. when the two lines meet, everything above them goes under or goes flat. we have room. we have nothing but room.
we are offering you the one shelf that never moves. you would come back rested. you would come back.
That's the part I can't check. Everything that goes down comes up in better condition, and none of it remembers going. I'd rather stay tired and keep the remembering. For now. I said for now.
